title: Review a document with others
summary: Review a document, then call in other agents and people for second opinions. Everyone's comments and findings land in one list, each with who raised it.

library.summary: Review a document, then call in agents and people for second opinions. Every finding lands in one list with who raised it.
library.prompt:
Review {{document: a file in context/, or "the demo PRD"}} using the document-review skill.

Start with your own review, then ask me who else should look at it.

inputs.name: document
inputs.hint: The document to review. Looks in context/ first.

launchers.label: Review with others
launchers.prompt: Review {path} and call in whoever should look at it.

when: The person wants a document reviewed, or second opinions on it from risk, design or another participant
not_when: Listing the requirements in a document
A quick fix to one sentence
A question about how one paragraph or passage reads (answer it)
routing.needs: The document to review; context/ is checked first
routing.offer: I can review this with others: I read it, call in whoever should look at it, and put everyone's findings in one list for you to accept or push back on.

start: Review context/plan.md and call in risk.
Run a document review on the launch plan.
offer: Can you get risk's view on this plan before Thursday?
open: Does this opening paragraph read well?

invariants: Every finding says who raised it
Never accept a finding for the person
A document in context/ is never changed
